items.name: Sherif's Menu
items.description: Drink not included. Starters: crispy vegetable fritters with seaside flavours, «Silver Spur Caesar Salad» with dried beef or tomato soup with smoked sweet paprika; mains: flamed-grilled steak skewers, roasted salmon marinated with dill or slow-cooked spelt cocotte with shiitake; desserts: Cowboys treat, chocolate-almond mille-feuille or pineapple ravioli filled with red berries

items.name: Kids' Menu
items.description: For children ages from 3 to 11. Starter, main course, dessert and drink. Drink: Vittel® 33 cl, orange or apple juice 25 cl or milk 20 cl; starters: toasted roll with turkey breast and Kiri cheese, crispy chicken salad with grated red cheddar, cherry tomatoes and sweetcorn or «Little Far West salad»; mains: stir-fried chicken with peanut sauce, pea purée and smoked cheddar pasta gratin, minced beef steak, pea purée and smoked cheddar pasta gratin or salmon fillet, beurre blanc and Silver rice; desserts: Wild west delight, Little cowboys treats (chocolate-hazelnut cookie with chocolate sauce) or pineapple carpaccio, chocolate-hazelnut cookie and caramelised popcorn. Or Disney Check menu: Little Far West salad, salmon steak, pineapple carpaccio, Vittel® 33 cl
